stile: digital oil painting, fantasy storybook illustration, rich warm colors, soft cinematic lighting, painterly brush strokes, no text, no letters, no watermark

vlad.descrizione: Vlad, a 13-year-old boy with short messy dark brown hair, brown eyes, light freckles, slim build, friendly curious face; he wears a small dark metal feather-shaped pendant on a thin chain around his neck; in winter scenes he wears a thick red-and-grey winter jacket, wool hat and scarf

vlad_armatura.descrizione: Vlad in his magical golden armor: polished golden plates with glowing golden runes, a glowing firebird feather emblem on the chest, golden helmet with a crest of orange fire feathers, warm orange glow between the plates; armor design may change with the situation but always golden with the firebird feather emblem

ludovica.descrizione: Ludovica, a 13-year-old girl with long wavy light brown hair, big expressive eyes, brave and quick; in winter scenes she wears a thick teal winter coat, a white wool hat and mittens

prof_siligato.descrizione: Professor Marcella Siligato, a friendly woman aged about 57 with short curly white hair (a pencil tucked into it), round glasses, kind lined face, warm smile, light shirt and long blue skirt

nonna_tanya.descrizione: Nonna Tatiana (Tanya), Vlad's grandmother, around 70, kind and mysterious, grey hair in a bun under a colorful Russian headscarf, warm amber eyes, embroidered dark cardigan, orange skirt, gentle smile; in winter scenes a long fur-collared coat

zinaida.descrizione: Zinaida, a tiny thin elderly Russian woman of about 75, very pale ice-blue eyes, weathered face, white braid under a heavy grey wool shawl, long dark felt coat and valenki felt boots, carries a carved wooden walking stick and an old brass lantern

baba_yaga.descrizione: Baba Yaga, a grumpy ancient Russian witch with a long hooked nose, wild grey hair, a few iron teeth, sharp bright black eyes, ragged dark patchwork dress and a red headscarf, holding a broom and a wooden mortar; funny and scary at once, not evil

koschei.descrizione: Koschei the Deathless, a very tall skeletal man with ash-grey skin, hollow ice-blue eyes, long white hair, a crown of black iron, a long black cloak made of raven feathers, thin long fingers; sad, proud and menacing

lupo.descrizione: The Grey Wolf of Russian fairy tales, a huge wolf the size of a horse with thick silver-grey fur, intelligent amber eyes, frost on its whiskers, calm and noble
